title: Fantastic class!
text: My daughter and I had the best time in the sangria and paella class! We met us with our host/chef Lorenzo at our meeting spot and then walked to the market. Lorenzo was very knowledgeable about the market and all the ingredients that we used to make our delicious drinks and food. We then went to the cooking lab where we were greeted by Aziz the assistant. Together Lorenzo and Aziz were a great team who provided an excellent class and unforgettable experience for me and my daughter.
author: 571charleenc

title: Paella class
text: Had a fantastic class and market tour with Lorenzo! And Maria was wonderful too.  The time went too fast.  Delicious food and Sangria.   Will plan another trip.
author: sharonkU3737CV

title: Amazing time with Alfonso!
text: Start your day by explore the amazing Mercat de la Boqueria to find the necessary ingredients for your paella. Return to the kitchen to enjoy tapas, sangria, and learning the in and outs of paella preparation. It’s a hands on experience that offers a nice change of pace for anyone visiting Barcelona. To top it off, Alfonso was a kind, patient and informative instructor. Great experience!
author: chadk492

title: Great Lesson
text: It’s a great opportunity to learn how to make paella as well as Sangria and King’s cake.  Also, how to shop for ingredients.  It was a small group so there was an opportunity to have a hands on experience and to eat when done. Pedro was a great instructor
author: James_P

title: Excellent way to spend an afternoon in Barcelona
text: What a fun afternoon!  Could not have had better instructors than Alf and Alberto.  Best Paella I have ever had and they served plenty of sangria.
author: sweetpumpkin63

title: Maria was amazing!
text: Maria was absolutely AMAZING!!!    So knowledge about the region and local ingredients and history.    My husband and I are celebrating our 20th anniversary and had the most memorable evening.   Thank you!!!!
author: Adventure56379343582

title: Delicious paella, fun class
text: This was such a fun class! Yaya was an excellent instructor and brought a lot of positive energy to the group. His assistant (sorry, I forgot his name), was super helpful behind the scenes. The paella we made was far better than any paella I tried in a restaurant during my trip. This is definitely a great class to take while you’re in Barcelona!
author: Tjcpeters

title: Paella and Sangria! What a great class!
text: Chefs YaYa and Marcelo did an excellent job! Yaya taught us so much about paella, sangria, cooking in this culture. The food was fun to prepare and delicious to eat! Thank you for a terrific experience!
author: Elizabeth_B

title: Fun night and dinner
text: We loved the experience! It was just a little hard to find
author: lamp07

title: Very interesting and fun
text: Our party of five really enjoyed this experience. There was only a group of 13 in our cooking class. It’s in a very cool space. It was very hands-on and informative and the food was delicious.
author: Kristin_L
